name: limit_delete_view_by_number_on_two_sheets
why: REPORT 8CD843 N57 (round 15, 28/10/2026). With the second sheet active, inspect_part gave V1 to the isometric view of that sheet, while on the first sheet V1 is the front view: the same number names two views. A plan that takes away «V1» after new_sheet takes away a view of the other sheet.
_what_changes_compared_to_the_twin: The view is asked by number, as in the twin, but the drawing has two sheets: the twin has one, and there V2 is not ambiguous.
defect_caught: That a view is taken away by its number on a drawing of two sheets. The message must say that the number counts the views of the active sheet, name the view it would have taken, and say nothing was touched.

expect.why: the plate of the drawing cases
a drawing is made on a saved part
from here on the active document is the drawing
the views of the first sheet: V1 there is the front view
the second sheet, active from here on
the state lists the views of the active sheet: here V1 is this isometric view

message_includes: numbers the views of the active sheet
